verdict: Built DO 2 and DO 3 with matching DO 4 tests. DO 1 dropped by decision; both stream files unchanged.
replayMismatch: API events.controller.ts: absent cursor tails head; literal 0 replays retained events; N resumes after N.
Last-Event-ID may advance the query cursor. No API change made or needed for the proposed fix.
table/useTableStream.ts initially opens ?cursor=0; table-stream.test.ts asserts this replay behaviour.
case-subscription.ts uses run/events.ts:runEventPath: cursor '0' means absent query, hence tail, not replay.
Late shared subscribers receive status only. runFrame also discards metrics; no history is retained.
Without URL job pins, initialStream has empty job IDs/metrics. reduceFrame discovers jobs/recipes/metrics.
useTableJobs is disabled without IDs; useTableData refresh never discovers them. Ready cannot fill history.
This loses prior changes even if the table is the first subscriber, not just when joining an existing stream.
smallestClosingChange: Add explicit replay intent to caseSubscriptions.subscribe, distinct from the existing '0 means tail' sentinel.
New table consumers request literal cursor=0. Cancel/await any shared reader before restarting that transport.
Dispatch replay frames even if older than the transport sequence; each table reducer deduplicates its history.
Keep ready/resync current-fact refresh and bounded replay-refusal recovery. Never open a second case reader.
Approve these replay/restart semantics before implementation; a live-only frame callback is insufficient.
Owned case-subscription.ts/useTableStream.ts can hold this; run/events.ts and the API can remain unchanged.

requestCounts.method: Code paths, not sockets/run. K=shared subscribed cases; P=active previews; J=0..2 selected jobs.

batchWithMap.before: K shared streams + up to P concurrent preview reads, including hidden pages.
batchWithMap.afterActual: K shared streams + up to P visible preview reads; zero new hidden reads or timers.
batchWithMap.oneCaseOnePreview: Visible before/after: 1 stream + up to 1 read; hidden: 1+1 before, 1+0 after drain.

tableWithSharedCaseConsumer.before: K shared streams + 1 table EventSource. J independent 2 s fallback pollers, even for ended jobs.
tableWithSharedCaseConsumer.afterActual: K+1 configured streams; only open/unknown-status jobs poll at 2 s during fallback (0..J).
tableWithSharedCaseConsumer.oneCaseTwoJobs: 2 healthy streams before/after. Fallback job reads: up to 2 before, 0 after both settle.
tableWithSharedCaseConsumer.withoutSharedConsumer: 1 table EventSource before/after; fallback reads up to J before, open jobs only after.

limits: Preview has one sequential read chain per file, not one global poll. In-flight hidden reads may finish.
Shared tick invokes refresh every 5 s if failed/unsettled; read fanout depends on consumers, not fixed slots.
React Query intervals pause hidden by default. Poll intervals are not permanently occupied connections.
Other queries/assets/uploads/demo-import excluded; these counts do not establish a whole-page socket ceiling.

implementation: queries.ts uses each query's current response to stop its interval; no new useTableData wiring needed.
Mapping disabled/unavailable also settle; needs_input stays open. Unknown status still polls on fallback.
readPreview.ts cancels hidden timers and guards initial/pending reads; visible resumes each active file now.
In-flight reads finish without duplication. Dispose removes the listener; caps/refusals/finished reads stay stopped.
7 polling cases test 2 s cadence, settlement, independent jobs, needs_input and stream-up; 3 visibility cases added.
Existing paging/cap tests now verify visibility cannot restart them; no new text, server or API changes.
